title: refactor(ci): modernize build matrix, consolidate lint/test workflows, and stabilize release automation
author: Evan Liu
description: Motivation: our CI build matrix has grown organically and causes long queue times and duplicated work across lint/test workflows; release automation uses unpinned actions and has flaky dry-runs. This PR consolidates the build matrix, unifies lint/test pipelines across languages, pins third-party actions, and adds a nightly repo-hygiene cron to run dependency audits and stale-branch cleanup. Changes are staged to minimize blast radius and preserve existing coverage. Checklist: [x] consolidate build matrices and reduce redundant permutations; [x] introduce conditional job paths to avoid running language-specific steps unnecessarily; [x] pin release actions to SHAs and add a dry-run + verification step; [x] add nightly repo-hygiene job (deps audit + auto-label stale branches); [x] add cache reuse across jobs and workspace restore to reduce upstream bandwidth; [ ] follow-up: platform-level cache improvements (ENG-6203). Related: ENG-5982, ENG-6120. Docs: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-5982/modernize-ci-build-matrix. This description lists high-level motivation and tasks; see commits and changed files for specifics.
commits: feat(ci): unify build matrix template and extract common job definitions
fix(ci): reduce matrix permutations by conditional job expansion and step-level conditionals
chore(ci): pin actions to SHAs and update node/rust/go versions in matrices
test(ci): increase integration test startup timeout and add retry wrapper for flaky service-startup
docs: update CI docs and add notes on concurrency limits and cache strategy
ci_checks: release/dry-run - passed (pinned actions, verification step OK)
review_comments: Priya: This is a great consolidation. Can we split the TypeScript and Go matrices so that long-running Go jobs don't block TS PRs? Suggest conditional matrices or separate job definitions.

Evan: Split matrices and added conditional paths to gate language-specific jobs using job-level if: contains(matrix.lang, 'go') style conditions. This reduces peak concurrency while preserving coverage.
Aisha: The release action referenced v2 of the third-party action; recommend pinning to a commit SHA to avoid supply-chain drift.
Evan: All third-party actions are pinned in actions/pinned-shas.txt and referenced by SHA in release.yml. Added a verification step to compute artifact checksums in dry-run.
Marco: Integration tests flaky on first run; after increasing startup timeout + retry wrapper they stabilized. Approving once CI is green.
Priya: Left a small nits comment about job naming for observability in dashboards.
Evan: Addressed nits and force-pushed a small rename of jobs and added step descriptions for traceability.
merge_commit_message: squash: refactor(ci): modernize build matrix and release automation - Consolidated lint/test workflows, reduced CI concurrency spikes, updated GH actions and node/go versions, pinned third-party actions, added nightly repo-hygiene. Fixes ENG-5982, ENG-6120.
release_notes:
- Modernized CI build matrix to reduce wasted parallelism and speed up median pipeline time
- Consolidated lint and test workflows to reduce duplicated steps across repos
- Pinned release automation actions and added dry-run verification
- Added nightly repo-hygiene job (deps audit + stale branch cleanup)
- Fixed flaky integration startup by adding retries and increasing timeouts
notes: The first CI run hit a flaky integration test (service-startup) that was fixed by increasing the startup timeout and adding a retry wrapper in test harness. Observed ~30% reduction in median CI duration for main after limiting matrix concurrency and reusing caches. Follow-up work: platform-level cache improvements (ENG-6203) and expanding the build-matrix template to SDK repos.
